children: Stitch Fix on September 23, 2026 reported fourth-quarter fiscal 2026 net revenue of $324.4 million and full-year net revenue of $1.3481 billion, with adjusted EBITDA of $10.8 million for the quarter and $53.4 million for the year. The company posted a fiscal 2026 net loss of $12.6 million (diluted loss per share $0.09) and generated $19.8 million of free cash flow for the year. Management provided guidance for fiscal 2027 revenue between $1.310 billion and $1.360 billion and adjusted EBITDA of $27 million to $42 million while noting a more challenging consumer environment.
Fourth-quarter net revenue: $324.4 million, up 4.2% year-over-year.
Full fiscal year net revenue: $1,348.1 million, up 6.4% year-over-year; gross profit $588.5 million and gross margin 43.7% (down 70 bps YoY).
Operating loss for Q4: $(4.4) million; full-year operating loss: $(21.7) million.
Net loss for fiscal 2026: $(12.6) million; diluted loss per share $0.09. Q4 net loss: $(2.1) million; diluted loss per share $0.02.
Adjusted EBITDA: Q4 $10.8 million (3.3% margin); Fiscal 2026 $53.4 million (4.0% margin). Free cash flow for fiscal 2026: $19.8 million.
Active clients totaled 2.277 million at quarter end, down 1.4% year-over-year; net revenue per active client was $592, up 7.8% year-over-year.
Management cited a transformational year with a reimagined client experience and improved assortment aimed at increasing personalization and market share in U.S. apparel, footwear and accessories.

First-quarter fiscal 2027 outlook was impacted by timing adjustments to some Fix shipments and an unintended change to the post-checkout offer flow in August that limited eligibility for additional Fix requests (issue corrected; expected impact limited to Q1).
Planned strategic investments in advertising and technology, including AI, are reflected in fiscal 2027 adjusted EBITDA guidance to support long-term growth.

Balance sheet and liquidity: cash, cash equivalents and investments totaled $220.9 million at year end and the company reported no debt; repurchased 2.7 million shares of Class A common stock for $11.3 million during Q4.
